scope: A proof-wide work program traced from the pinned source endpoint. Complete source imports and endpoint-field accounting do not constitute a full theorem-dependency or mathematical verification.
preferred_target: One compatible arithmetic construction at each required scale, controlling an averaged discrepancy and explicit finite errors with a total exponent loss tending to zero on whole windows.
source_supplier: The complete coherent-family route remains an available supplier. Its separate Galois-construction supplier is replaced in the preferred route by the fully compared classical theorem; independent theta and geometric obligations are retained.

work_packages.title: Analytic conclusion from vanishing exponent loss
work_packages.goal: For a fixed target character chi, prove that bounds H_j(x)<=M_j x^(1/2+delta_j), delta_j->0, on arbitrarily late whole multiplicative windows exclude its zeros to the right of one half, when every finite positive H_j retains chi or its conjugate.
work_packages.uniformity: For fixed j, H_j, its finite family and positive weights, M_j and b_j>1 precede the windows. They may vary with j; no uniform positive lower bound on the target coefficient is needed.
work_packages.next_step: Use the proved criterion as the final acceptance test; do not demand bounded accuracy-dependent constants without need.
acceptance: The target character or its conjugate occurs with positive coefficient in every H_j; H_j is fixed within its own window sequence
Bounds hold throughout each window, not only at isolated x
Every arithmetic loss is included in delta_j

work_packages.title: Compatible constructions with controlled average losses
work_packages.goal: Construct actual nonempty arithmetic/theta data whose averaged discrepancy, finite Fourier-projection error and sampled transfer error satisfy the proved finite-character bound. The full source EAtH/CoreAtH package is one stronger supplier.
work_packages.uniformity: For each accuracy, thresholds and the total exponent loss are fixed before all x in arbitrarily late whole windows. Choices of the host at x may vary with x.
work_packages.next_step: For RH specialize to conductor one and the four-character projection. Construct one coherent datum with either verified pooled translation symmetry or a directly bounded symmetry error. Control the signed companion and actual transfer budget; preserve the fixed analytic target across every whole window.
acceptance: Each accuracy retains the target in a positive combination fixed throughout its own window sequence
Nonempty actual coefficient/word spaces
Exact identification of maps and periods
Bounds on every x in the chosen windows
The averaging weights and subgroup pushforwards are exact; a surjection alone does not preserve uniform averages
All finite-error terms are bounded throughout each whole window, even when ambient groups and ranks grow
Fixed quotient labels require balanced fibre counts and fixed primitive-character identifications when used to keep an analytic family fixed.
Pooled translation symmetry is a separate construction hypothesis; existing scale bounds do not imply it.

work_packages.title: Auxiliary characters, fields and nonvacuous selections
work_packages.goal: Choose admissible fields, characters, intervals and genuinely existing selected data, with all closure conditions used in later steps.
work_packages.uniformity: Keep conductor, degree, prime and interval choices in their required order. Family-level constants precede points and selected indices.
work_packages.next_step: Use uniform Dirichlet quasi-RH and exponent14 where applicable; prove the actual existence and closure conditions for the selected construction.
acceptance: No empty-family or empty-index substitute
Character estimates cover the actual finite family chosen for each fixed accuracy
No extrapolation from Dirichlet to varying-field Hecke characters

work_packages.title: Cyclotomic cohomology and integral congruence bounds
work_packages.goal: Obtain the character-length bounds and integral congruence control needed for exceptional subspaces, retaining full decomposition-group local conditions.
work_packages.uniformity: Bounds must hold in the varying allowed fields and primes at each fixed accuracy, with total loss compatible with W01.
source_contracts: cohomological inputs in LitThin and VWin
work_packages.next_step: Complete complementary-parity cases and quantitative integral congruences; keep the K-theory exponent14 route.
acceptance: Retain torsion and primes dividing degree/order
Rational adjoint vanishing does not imply integral length bounds
Prove any stronger uniformity actually used downstream

work_packages.title: Classical Galois representations with the required local conditions
work_packages.goal: Supply the Row0b representation for every regular algebraic polarized cuspidal representation over the allowed CM fields, including the specified local and infinity data.
work_packages.uniformity: All field, prime, embedding, rank, representation and local-place quantifiers must match.
work_packages.next_step: Use the adopted classical theorem and universal weak-correspondence transport. Reuse the same representation in repeated row fields and the Selmer windows; preserve its local, weight and period normalizations in every consumer.
acceptance: Infinity-type and duality normalizations agree
All away-prime and above-prime local clauses matched
The same result supplies both repeated Row fields and VWin
A classical shortcut removes only this supplier, not independent theta identities
The full local laws, depth-zero type formula, and global period-model dictionary are matched before universal weak-correspondence transport
Good-preimage comparison uses one global Galois representation for every allowed weak correspondence

work_packages.title: Integral theta maps and divisibility
work_packages.goal: Construct the actual nonzero maps on specified integral lattices and prove selected-prime and auxiliary-level divisibility for every test vector.
work_packages.uniformity: Coefficient fields, ordinary periods, lattice denominators and chosen primes are fixed in the order used by the same analytic maps.
source_contracts: integral rows and selected theta constructions in Hyps
work_packages.next_step: Prove seed nonvanishing and sharp level-prime divisibility; retain all clearing factors and period normalizations.
acceptance: The map whose divisibility is proved is the map whose norm is estimated
No dropped denominator
Nonzero map and actual integral image, not a formal surrogate

work_packages.title: Archimedean restriction and local residue positivity
work_packages.goal: Identify the full operator matrix, its restrictions, and the actual integrated residue forms, including the source word order and admissibility conditions.
work_packages.uniformity: The fixed-rank theorems are distinguished from quantitative bounds for growing ranks and words.
work_packages.next_step: Use the completed local source dictionary and original-parameter positivity on smooth coefficients; treat merely finite differentiability and quantitative growing-chain estimates separately.
acceptance: Reverse source-list order when assigning chronological insertions
One positive pairing constant independent of word
Original-parameter separation is not replaced by a stronger shifted condition
No unsupported separate global L2 claim for transferred factors

work_packages.title: Global theta matching, orbital energy and norms
work_packages.goal: Prove the normalized global theta-integral identities, their nonzero scalar, the rank-reduction laws, and uniform global energy estimates for the actual maps.
work_packages.uniformity: Common Haar measures, local normalizations, Hecke L-values and rank thresholds; estimates uniform in the scale for each accuracy.
work_packages.next_step: Complete coordinate-size and weighted lattice-pair estimates and the normalized global matching; then obtain the norms of W06.
acceptance: Local positivity alone does not prove the global identity
Unique nonzero scalar with the exact normalization
All required absolute convergence or justified iterated pairings
No omitted rank or level dependence

work_packages.title: Automorphic spectrum, finite-group characters and counting
work_packages.goal: Supply Green character theory, spectral decay, finite-dimensional rows, mass/dimension comparison, counting and irreducibility conditions for the selected construction.
work_packages.uniformity: Constants in counting and spectral estimates precede the points, indices and subspaces they bound.
source_contracts: spectral and counting fields of Hyps
work_packages.next_step: Map the remaining source counting/irreducibility interfaces to the reconstructed spectral estimates and precise classical inputs.
acceptance: Green means finite-GL cuspidal parametrization
No assumption that a dimension estimate gives the missing map identity
Maintain measure and formal-degree conventions

work_packages.title: Geometric logarithmic-covolume estimate
work_packages.goal: Prove the mean degree bound for the actual cuspidal section lattices with their Petersson/period metrics; transport it through exact quotient, type-cut and raw Hilbert-Samuel surplus budgets.
work_packages.uniformity: For each admissible closed family, one common constant and eventual threshold precede all points and indices.
work_packages.next_step: Bound the actual mean-volume/height input and total Hilbert-Samuel surplus before the growing parameter varies; identify determinant descent and any type averaging with the same selected lattices. Existing upper rank-share is a sufficient supplier, not needed by the new abstract budget.
acceptance: Actual geometric lattices identified with the construction
Degree, metric and self-intersection normalizations retained
Existing abstract lattice estimates are not accepted as this geometric theorem
An exponentially small exceptional rank or an ambient maximal-slope estimate is only one sufficient supplier of the actual defect budget
Small discarded rank alone does not control its degree; retain the integral splitting index
Keep positive component ranks when multiplying the source slope formula.
Control the raw surplus remainder in mean; do not replace an effective uniform bound for moving varieties by a fixed-variety asymptotic.
Average types only with the proved rank weights, and retain the integral index.

work_packages.title: Weighted slope comparison and the complete average budget
work_packages.goal: Use weighted lower quotient and divisor inequalities with the actual nonlinear frame penalty, then average over translations and apply the finite-character comparison for the same maps.
work_packages.uniformity: Every scale-dependent and accuracy-dependent loss is recorded. Only total loss tending to0 is analytically required; fixed-accuracy scale uniformity is essential.
work_packages.next_step: Use the actual signed projection/transfer identity and weighted frame moments. In the symmetric four-character case, retain three mean weights and the logarithmic-dispersion penalty, then bound the single signed companion mean. The same integral maps and geometric metrics must supply these terms.
acceptance: No independent existential choices with incompatible data
Do not use a conditional reduction as its own construction input
Produce cofinal whole windows for each accuracy with a fixed positive combination retaining the target
Retain the source family route until an alternative supplier is actually proved
Keep the actual frame cost or prove a valid upper bound; upper slope and pairwise variation hypotheses may be omitted only when that cost is controlled directly

coherence: All fields share one familyclass A and selection sigma. Measures/maps/spaces referenced by selP,selB,selS must be transported coherently; separate constructions cannot be substituted without an equality/compatibility theorem.
nonvacuity: RawSel on a possibly empty A is not sufficient. Retain hEx (MinkDiv implies ExS) and its classical MinkDiv input: ExS constructs admissible families under prescribed host requirements. Closed conditions and nRest must hold on those actual families.
